clue.text: Letter used as a testimonial

definitions.meaning: a letter or symbol of a writing system, such as a Chinese ideogram
an old word for a written reference describing someone's qualities

explanation.surface: A letter of reference is being offered as a testimonial for a job applicant.
explanation.definitionFit: A written symbol is a character, and an old-fashioned employer's reference was also called a character.

clue.text: Chap without work needs to be optimistic

indicators.note: here without means outside, so the word for chap goes around the work piece

parts.note: a chap is a he, a male
op is short for opus, a musical work

explanation.surface: An unemployed man is told he must keep his spirits up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' is used in its old sense of 'outside', not 'lacking'.
explanation.definitionFit: To expect good things is to look forward with confidence, the verb sense.

clue.text: Master returned only to get food

indicators.note: returned means the title for a master is read backwards

parts.note: sir is a respectful title for a master
sole means only, as in 'the sole survivor'

explanation.surface: The master of the house came home just to have something to eat.
explanation.definitionFit: A fried patty of minced meat or fish is an example of food.

clue.text: Kindly invest money in bond

indicators.note: to invest is to put money into something, so the money letter goes into the bond
in shows where the money goes: inside the word for bond

parts.note: cement bonds bricks together
L stands for pound, the British unit of money (from Latin libra)

explanation.surface: A kindly adviser recommends putting cash into a government bond.
explanation.definitionFit: Merciful and lenient describe the same mild, kindly temperament.

clue.text: Relax in private, as everyone does

indicators.note: in says the letters sit inside the run of words private, as everyone

explanation.surface: Everyone likes to unwind away from public view.
explanation.definitionFit: To relax is to let up or loosen, the verb sense of comfort and rest.

clue.text: Anagrammatize "Lift the witch's curse"

definitions.meaning: to make an anagram is cryptically to break up a word's spelling
to free someone from an enchantment

explanation.surface: A puzzling instruction to rearrange a witch's curse so it is undone.
explanation.definitionFit: Ending an enchantment is undoing it; jumbling a word humorously wrecks its spelling.

clue.text: Apologetic for being so run down

definitions.meaning: in poor or neglected condition, dilapidated

explanation.surface: Someone says sorry for feeling so exhausted.
explanation.definitionFit: Being contrite puts one in a sorry frame of mind; a shabby, neglected thing is in poor condition.

clue.text: Taking up residence beforehand is appealing

parts.note: pre- is a prefix meaning before
possessing a place, as a spirit possesses a body, is occupying it

explanation.surface: Moving into a house early is an attractive idea.
explanation.walkthrough: The charade puts 'beforehand' first although it comes last in the clue.
explanation.definitionFit: A prepossessing person makes a favourable first impression, so is attractive.

clue.text: Rex tucked into mashed potatoes with little discernment

indicators.note: tucked into means the king's letter is placed inside the rearranged vegetables
mashed potatoes are broken up, so the letters of potatoes are rearranged

parts.note: R stands for Rex, Latin for king

explanation.surface: A king tucks into a plate of mash, showing no refinement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tucked into' reads like eating, but it signals the king's letter going inside the scrambled vegetables.
explanation.definitionFit: A lack of refined judgement in matters of style is the idiom's meaning.

clue.text: Foreign nobleman disconsolate before rocket-launch

parts.note: a count is a continental European nobleman, equivalent to a British earl
down means sad, dejected

explanation.surface: A gloomy European aristocrat watches a rocket being launched.
explanation.definitionFit: The final numbers called in reverse precede a lift-off.

clue.text: Love a fellow in the Middle East

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, shaped like the letter O
a fellow is a man

explanation.surface: Romance with a chap somewhere in the Middle East.
explanation.definitionFit: This sultanate is a country located on the Arabian peninsula.

clue.text: Blush when wounded in the corrida

definitions.meaning: to turn red in the face, read as two words
pierced by a bull's horns in the bullring

explanation.surface: A matador flushes with shame after being hurt by the bull.
explanation.walkthrough: A corrida is a Spanish bullfight.
explanation.definitionFit: Going red in the face is blushing, and a bull's horn stabbing someone wounds them.

clue.text: Sailor left old Scandinavian city

parts.note: OS is ordinary seaman

explanation.surface: A sailor departed a historic Nordic city.
explanation.definitionFit: Norway's capital is a city in Scandinavia.

clue.text: That bread is mine, thank you

parts.note: a pit is a coal mine
ta is British informal for thank you

explanation.surface: Someone politely claims a piece of flatbread as their own.
explanation.definitionFit: A flat Middle Eastern pocket loaf is a kind of bread.

clue.text: Small, solid piece of porcelain

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for small, as on clothing labels
hard means solid, firm

explanation.surface: A little hard fragment of china is described.
explanation.definitionFit: A broken fragment of pottery or glass is a sharp piece of it.

clue.text: It offers the seaman a step-up

definitions.text: It offers the seaman a step-up

parts.words: It offers the seaman a step-up
parts.note: a small rope fixed across a ship's shrouds forms a rung for sailors climbing the rigging

explanation.surface: Something gives a sailor a boost up in the world.
explanation.definitionFit: These rope rungs on rigging are the steps sailors climb aloft by.

clue.text: Reforms are then established. Capital!

indicators.note: reforms means the letters of are then are formed again into a new order

explanation.surface: A government announces that reforms are now in place.
explanation.walkthrough: 'established' merely confirms the new arrangement; this older spelling of the Iranian capital is now usually Tehran.
explanation.definitionFit: This city is the capital of Iran.

clue.text: A comparatively good assistant

parts.note: better is the comparative of good

explanation.surface: A helper who is somewhat superior to the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: One who helps or encourages, usually in wrongdoing, is an accomplice or helper.

clue.text: Forbear to hold Italian monk in check

indicators.note: to hold means the word for check goes around the Italian monk

parts.note: to rein is to check or restrain
Fra is the title for an Italian friar

explanation.surface: An ancestor is urged to keep a wayward Italian friar under control.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Forbear' looks like a noun meaning ancestor, but it is the verb meaning to hold back.
explanation.definitionFit: To abstain from doing something is to hold back.

clue.text: Pole begged to be given a shower

parts.note: S is the south pole
prayed means begged or implored

explanation.surface: A Polish man pleaded to be allowed to wash.
explanation.definitionFit: Water or liquid scattered in droplets over something is a shower.

clue.text: Cold in a summer shoe? It's an outrage

indicators.note: in means the cold letter is placed inside the summer shoe

parts.note: a sandal is an open shoe worn in summer
C is the abbreviation for cold, as on taps

explanation.surface: Someone is outraged at catching a chill while wearing open shoes.
explanation.definitionFit: A disgraceful event causes public outrage.

clue.text: Drink a toast in support of school games

parts.note: a toast in someone's honour begins 'To ...'
PE is physical education, games lessons at school

explanation.surface: Pupils raise their glasses to toast sports day.
explanation.definitionFit: To tope is an old verb for drinking alcohol heavily.

clue.text: No longer keen on Albert getting organs

parts.note: to go off something is to lose your liking for it
Al is short for Albert

explanation.surface: A man named Albert has lost interest in getting organ transplants.
explanation.definitionFit: Entrails and internal parts of an animal used as food are its organs.

clue.text: Hoard only five letters

annotationWithheld.why: Clue held as 'Hoard only five letters (4)': no parse of 'only five letters' gives STOW and no source gives the true clue; likely OCR garble

clue.text: Repercussion from a speech on employment

indicators.note: from says the letters are taken out of the run of words speech on employment

explanation.surface: Fallout follows a politician's speech about jobs.
explanation.definitionFit: A reverberation or after-effect is a repercussion.

clue.text: Feature honourable man holding office

parts.note: CH is Companion of Honour, a British honour
a party in power is said to be in

explanation.surface: A newspaper profiles a decorated man who holds a public post.
explanation.definitionFit: The lower part of the face is one of a person's features.

clue.text: Simplistic writing

definitions.meaning: seeing issues as clear-cut, without shades of grey
as in 'put it in' this, meaning on paper

explanation.surface: Writing that is too simple.
explanation.definitionFit: Clear-cut judgements see only two shades; printed text is dark ink on pale paper.

clue.text: Tiny waif discovered by Heather

parts.note: found means discovered
ling is a common heather

explanation.surface: A little orphan is found by a woman called Heather.
explanation.definitionFit: An abandoned infant found and taken in is a small orphan.
